_how_to_edit: Each tab on the menu is one entry in 'sections'. Add a dish by copying one {...} block inside 'items'. 'price' is a plain number in Jamaican dollars (1200 shows as J$1,200); leave it as null until you know it. 'dineIn' and 'toGo' control the Dine-in and To go stamps on a dish: true shows the stamp, false or null hides it. 'description' and 'note' are optional: use "" to leave them out. 'favourites' is the label of house favourites shown beside the menu: each entry is a name, with an optional short 'note'. Save the file and the website updates.
